description:
Want to turn Claude into a professional video editor? These 5 GitHub projects can help you build a powerful video creation workflow. 

This is Part 2 of the GitHub repos that upgrade Claude’s video editing capabilities.

Here are the tools you need to know:

1. Motion Skills
Give Claude the ability to create professional motion graphics.

Animated typography

Dynamic charts

Explainer videos

Broadcast-quality motion design

2. Whisper
Turn video speech into clean, usable text.

Generate transcripts from audio.

Create subtitles and captions.

Translate speech into text.

Support transcript-based video editing.

3. Awesome Claude Video Skills
Discover a curated collection of 180 GitHub repositories covering AI video editing, animation, motion graphics, and video generation.

4. Three.js Skills
Turn Claude into a 3D scene and animation builder.

Create interactive 3D worlds.

Animate objects.

Add realistic lighting.

Build dynamic camera movements and visual effects.

5. Hyperframes
Create and render videos directly from code.

Turn HTML and CSS into videos.

Animate text and graphics.

Build product demos, ads, and explainers.

Imagine combining these tools to build your own AI-powered video production workflow.

Save this post for your next Claude Code setup.

Follow for Part 3 and more useful GitHub projects.
